issues.title: [M0] Preserve effective defaults and explicitness in importer and semantic IR
issues.body:
**Proposed milestone:** M0. **Track:** SCAP-NG roadmap.

**Goal:** Distinguish source-omitted, source-explicit, XSD-defaulted, inherited, and documented implicit semantics without changing assessment truth.

**Work:** Generalize `tools/oval_semantic_ir.py` beyond the currently scoped Test/State/State-entity `effective_attributes` while preserving raw source attributes. Avoid guessing unverified behaviors. Track conditional defaults such as var_check only with var_ref and record entity cardinality separately from Test existence.

**Done when:** Schema-backed effective semantics are represented with provenance, round-trip tests prove equality of omitted/explicit-default forms and inequality of nondefault forms, all unsupported cases receive diagnostics, and no false diff inflation is concealed.

**Dependencies:** XSD default audit; existing tests `test_oval_effective_attributes.py` and `test_state_entity_roundtrip.py`. **Status:** Partial implementation committed.

**Tracking:** See `ROADMAP.md` for milestone definitions and dependencies. Do not close without linking committed implementation and proof. 

### Required-versus-defaulted Test attribute correction — 2026-09-30

Verified against pinned [upstream OVAL 5.12.3 `oval-definitions-schema.xsd` TestType](https://github.com/OVAL-Community/OVAL/blob/v5.12.3/oval-schemas/oval-definitions-schema.xsd): `check` is `use="required"` (NO default), whereas `check_existence` defaults `at_least_one_exists` and `state_operator` defaults `AND`. Prior v003 lowering and generic IR silently invented `check="all"` when missing. This is a potentially misleading repair of **invalid** publisher content, not an OVAL hidden default.

- [`04de105`](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/04de105a9f1699246e20d47db0381eaacb6b998d) makes v003 reject missing `check` with `invalid_oval_missing_required_test_check`.
- [`8bffd1d`](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/8bffd1d8fcf2e402f5a727bc7634c5df3434e0f3) prevents generic semantic IR from fabricating `all`, recording absent TestType required fields explicitly.
- [`668a296`](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/668a296280ab1d0d710d8c24e6019fd116267b0e) and [`aa36dff`](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/aa36dff8f7eb746a8a16ece114200e75ffcb69a4) add importer and full lowerer focused negative fixtures.

Important: commits are **not acceptance evidence**. The relevant smoke, corpus, and Self-Assertion runs must complete; keep #9 open for inherited/conditional default proof and other required attributes.


### 2026-09-30 base-type deprecated default provenance

Authoritative pinned OVAL 5.12.3 `oval-definitions-schema.xsd` declares `deprecated` optional with `default="false"` on DefinitionType, TestType, ObjectType, StateType and VariableType. [58e06e4](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/58e06e4c30a424d1c573e0783e20c2857d1746f6) records the effective default and explicit-versus-inferred origin in generic semantic IR on all five kinds without changing executable native checks. [2d33156](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/2d33156a4041f2b6d822d660add2a4d3b0fc1623) adds tests for omitted, explicit false and explicit true, including parsed IR. CI [run 36739844867](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36739844867) was queued when recorded; no passing status yet claimed. Keep open for inherited platform-specific attributes and other defaults.


### Schema-backed importer-default parity gate — 2026-09-30

Seven named generic bases (DefinitionType, TestType, ObjectType, StateType, VariableType, EntityStateSimpleBaseType, EntityStateComplexBaseType) now have [a pinned-XSD importer-default crosswalk](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/blob/main/tools/scap_ng_roundtrip_v003/verify_ir_defaults_against_xsd.py) connected to the [XSD audit workflow](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/workflows/audit-upstream-oval-xsd-defaults.yml). This deliberately excludes conditional documented `var_check` and collector-specific behaviors. See issue #8; do not claim passing gate until [run 36740291944](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36740291944) completes.


### 2026-09-30 source defaults versus native NG no-hidden-defaults regression

A RHEL9 reviewer noticed inconsistent `variable_check` / `datatype` / existence fields in generated automated Assessments. Confirmed concrete gap: `tools/scap_upconvert_v003/build_rhel9_review_slice.py` carried OVAL source omission forward into **native** NG State/Object source. An old test `test_default_absence_remains_unmaterialized_in_native` even enforced that. Source provenance and runtime-explicit native NG must be distinct.

Source-backed facts from OVAL 5.12.3 `oval-definitions-schema.xsd`:
- `EntityAttributeGroup` defaults: `datatype=string`, `operation=equals`, `mask=false`; `var_check=all` is **documented implicit** only if `var_ref` is supplied.
- `EntityStateSimpleBaseType` / `EntityStateComplexBaseType` also default `entity_check=all`, `check_existence=at_least_one_exists`. Test-level `check_existence` is separate.
- Record entities require `datatype=record` (Schematron/documentation), while record fields inherit EntityAttributeGroup and `entity_check=all`.
- `VariableType.datatype` is **required**, with **no** default; a missing variable datatype is malformed XML and SHALL fail, rather than invent `string`.
- A referenced variable with **zero values** is NOT merely another cardinality default: the OVAL common `EntityAttributeGroup` documentation distinguishes Object reference (object entity not existing) from State reference (evaluation error). Current NG source does not yet visibly encode this difference at variable reference sites. **This remains a semantic fidelity and reviewer-handoff blocker** until a native construct and independent conformance fixtures prove the behavior (do not silently assign it to a generic variable `required` flag). External interactive input `required: true; cardinality: one_or_more` is a different constraint.

Implementation checkpoint: [commit ea84579](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/ea84579e456df6ebb39b27c46585d212e0578487) materializes Object and State entity known defaults and `var_check` when used, materializes literal-component datatype=string, rejects missing mandatory variable datatype, flags record entity datatype mismatches, and changes the old test to require explicit defaults. CI [smoke](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36744881617), [Self-Assertion](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36744881768), [RHEL9 generation](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36744881502) and [NIWC census](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36744881627) triggered and were **not yet complete** at the time of this entry. Future changes must be driven by these runs, especially platform-specific fixed datatypes and record field semantics.

**Acceptance**: no hidden behavior-affecting defaults in native NG for supported assessments; no default invented for required source attributes; compare generated output and pinned XML semantics (not byte identity), assert missing-variable behavior separately, capture explicit-vs-implicit source provenance without leaking OVAL syntax into native source, regenerate RHEL9 and Win11 only after gates.

### Whole-benchmark default audit, September 30

[Audit 36745241522](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36745241522) inspected 879 RHEL9 assessment files (434 automated, 670 checks, 2,579 entities, 644 state entities, 67 variable usages) and initially reported 33 findings. The follow-up audit identified 24 real omissions in three custom Linux platform applicability assessments (two predicates each missing datatype, mask, entity_check, and entity_existence), plus 9 false alarms for independent.variable Object var_ref ID-selector elements. That element is not an entity var_ref attribute and does not have a var_check default. [f6ad758](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/f6ad75894a3104c2217217ae955d68b429176515) fixes both generator and auditing rule; regenerated RHEL9 source now visibly contains platform predicates with the explicit fields. [bb574b6](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/bb574b695bb02a2387d794a7bdcff799ec04ebf9) chains the audit after successful source generation, avoiding GitHub token push-trigger gaps. Final updated audit [36745792918](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36745792918) was queued at note time; do not claim its outcome prematurely.

Separately, variable with zero values is not yet explicitly represented in the runtime-native contract: OVAL differentiates Object no-match versus State error. This remains an open fidelity blocker distinct from var_check and external input.required.


### Confirmed whole-benchmark audit result

[Run 36745792918](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36745792918) PASSED at revision `bb574b69` after source regeneration. It independently enumerated **879 RHEL9 assessment files**, **434 automated assessments**, **670 automated checks**, **2,579 entity usages**, **644 State entity predicates**, **67 variable references**, **67 variable declarations**, **9 independent.variable ID-selector exceptions**, with **0 omitted defaults** under the auditor's currently defined scope. Synthetic positive/negative default fixtures also passed. This closes the observed *source explicitness* regression for the covered constructs, **not the separate zero-value variable behavior or evaluator parity**. Whole-NIWC census remains queued; do not treat as complete benchmark handoff.

comments.body:
Mask default clarification from RHEL9/Windows11 review:

Pinned OVAL 5.12.3 `EntityAttributeGroup` defines optional `mask` with XSD default `false`. The attribute is a **results-redaction directive**, not an assessment truth/collection selector: when effective `mask=true`, corresponding sensitive collected values must not be reproduced in the OVAL Results copy of System Characteristics. Conflicts resolve toward masking.

Current v003 lowering materializes `mask: false` into native NG for every affected Object/State entity because `effective_entity_attributes()` emits the effective OVAL default. The semantic IR already preserves origin (`explicit` vs `xsd_default`).

Design direction for review:
- Preserve effective OVAL `mask` and explicit-vs-default origin in migration IR/evidence.
- Native NG authoring SHOULD treat result redaction as explicit opt-in; inherited/default OVAL `mask=false` SHOULD NOT need to appear on every native predicate.
- Explicit source `mask=true` MUST survive conversion and map to the NG result-redaction control.
- Explicit source `mask=false` may be retained in provenance/evidence even if omitted from normalized native NG.
- Removing default-false serialization from native authoring is acceptable only if the NG schema/spec defines the default unambiguously and round-trip semantic comparison can reconstruct OVAL's effective false.
- Do not remove other behavior-affecting defaults merely by analogy; this exception is justified because mask controls disclosure of result values rather than Test truth.

This should be reflected in the normalizer/compiler and results-schema work so redaction semantics stay explicit and auditable without flooding authored Assessment YAML with `mask: false`.

issues.title: [M0] Audit every OVAL 5.12.3 XSD default and inherited behavior
issues.body:
**Proposed milestone:** M0. **Track:** SCAP-NG roadmap.

**Goal:** Resolve hidden/defaulted OVAL semantics across the *complete* pinned 5.12.3 XSD set.

**Work:** Traverse complexType/extension/restriction/attributeGroup inheritance; catalog explicit XSD `default`/`fixed`, optional elements, platform-family behaviors, Schematron, and prose-only defaults. Source-anchor each rule and distinguish inheritance from documented implicit runtime behavior. Include State entity existence, var_check, entity_check, existence evaluation, masks, recurse behaviors, set/filter defaults, and restrictions.

**Done when:** A machine-readable schema-derived catalog and human-readable review, parser tests, unresolved cases, and upstream XSD defect list are committed. No blanket fallback based solely on attribute names.

**Dependencies:** Pinned upstream 5.12.3 schemas; existing issue #6 remains the specification transcription work. **Status:** Partial tooling exists; full audit unresolved.

**Tracking:** See `ROADMAP.md` for milestone definitions and dependencies. Do not close without linking committed implementation and proof. 

### Round-trip diff acceptance criteria (2026-09-30 clarification)

- Compare pinned original OVAL XML with re-emitted XML both **structurally** and **semantically**; XML bytes/attribute order are not the equivalence criterion.
- Classify each delta as: (a) default made explicit but effective semantics unchanged; (b) normalization with demonstrated equivalence; (c) genuine semantic mismatch; (d) unsupported/ambiguous requiring review. Do not allow (a) to obscure (c).
- Include state-level `entity_existence`, `var_check`, `entity_check`, inherited schema defaults, object `behaviors`, test `check_existence`, set/filter defaults and scope of element/cardinality defaults in focused fixtures.
- Preserve original omitted-vs-explicit distinction in semantic IR/provenance even if native NG output chooses to express the effective default explicitly.
- Report separate per-feature and per-corpus counts for Self-Assertion conformance versus published STIG migration; treat schema-valid XML or a quiet textual diff as insufficient proof.
- Record any OVAL 5.12.3 schema flaw/ambiguity with exact schema location and a candidate upstream correction, without silently changing imported source meaning.


### Incremental evidence — 2026-09-30

Commit [`4638011`](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/46380111c2e06fe099b16ae1c04b1c0992da3880) extends `tools/oval_xsd_default_inventory.py` to record per-source SHA-256 and separately enumerate **unresolved** XSD inheritance edges (`extension`/`restriction` bases and `attributeGroup`/`group` references). This improves reproducibility and prevents treating declaration inventory as resolved effective semantics. It is **not** a completed inheritance resolver or full default census. Follow-up: run against pinned complete 5.12.3 schema set, inspect cross-namespace/reference resolution and validate generated counts with fixtures; add CI test evidence. Issue remains open.


### Active regression iteration — 2026-09-30

[`9cc4047`](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/9cc4047c90132ad0980884848652330c108ffac3) extends the pre-existing authoritative 5.12.3 schema audit, `tools/scap_ng_roundtrip_v003/audit_oval_xsd_defaults.py`, to emit source SHA-256 pins, `fixed-values.json` and `attribute-group-links.json`, including unresolved references. It does NOT yet perform inherited attribute-group resolution.

A real main-branch push queued [full schema audit run 36736188555](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36736188555), plus [round-trip smoke 36736188653](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36736188653), [Self-Assertion 36736188515](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36736188515), [Windows 36736188539](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36736188539), [Linux 36736188545](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36736188545), and [diverse-platform 36736188580](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36736188580). At log time these runs were queued, not validated successes. Next: inspect their actual outcomes/artifacts, audit inherited defaults and material differences, and correct failures without suppressing them.


### Completed audit execution evidence — 2026-09-30

Pinned OVAL 5.12.3 [audit run 36736188555](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36736188555) succeeded. **54 XSD files, 0 parse errors, 280 explicit defaults, 27 fixed-value declarations, 1,642 type inheritance relations, seven attribute-group references, two attribute-group declarations**, plus 1,357 semantic documentation passages (296 matching implicit/default language). This is an inventory milestone, not complete effective type-closure or conformance certification. Round-trip smoke, Self-Assertion, and Windows/Linux/diverse-platform workflows also passed at `9cc4047`. Next: resolve inheritance/group references against qualified types, classify defaults by test/object/state/variable applicability, extend converter IR with schema-backed provenance, and re-run corpus gates.


### Named XSD reference resolution — incremental implementation, 2026-09-30

- [`ec3e15c`](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/ec3e15c673163c06146eef1dff338dc26c942e98): complete-pinned-XSD inventory now resolves **direct** prefixed global complex/simple type and attribute-group references to declarations, distinguishing XSD builtins, ambiguous declarations, unresolved references and missing namespace mappings. It deliberately does **not** compute transitive effective default closure.
- [`a1f947c`](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/a1f947ce6c1c0a4d3419bcd060bd3c899fd8deeb): synthetic 45-schema regression with declared group, derived type, builtin, fixed/default values and unresolved reference.
- [`344477c`](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/344477c0cea47430bd1a2cbc536ae7f938ac7d70): wires this regression into [OVAL schema-audit CI run 36737885506](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36737885506). Run was queued at the time of this update; do not claim a pass until verified.
- Follow-on: inspect actual pinned-corpus resolution categories and audit unresolved reference cases before deriving any effective defaults; assess platform-specific behaviors without generic attribute-name fallbacks.

### Direct reference-resolution evidence (first pinned run)

[Successful audit run 36737840455](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36737840455) on commit `ec3e15c`: among **1,664 inspected QName references**, 1,558 mapped uniquely to named global schema declarations and 106 were XSD builtins; no ambiguous or unresolved references were reported in the printed summary. This is a **direct-reference inventory**, not transitive effective default closure. The subsequent synthetic-fixture-gated run must be checked separately. Issue stays open.


### 2026-09-30 transitive structural-default work

- [421f502](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/421f5021a48baf6106815a7e67c34657aae0fc17) adds a conservative transitive default inventory for **globally named complex types** and attribute groups. Missing, ambiguous, cyclical, or wildcard-dependent relationships are flagged rather than guessed; anonymous types and collector-specific prose semantics are outside this bounded resolver.
- [91b82c2](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/91b82c2b740f351a2d5156c83d7c70230cabc792) integrates the report into the pinned XSD audit; [dbfc1e8](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/dbfc1e8b7d38a6d43f74f8f1197aaf6049bf2917) tests inherited and incomplete paths.
- [Successful run 36739564992](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36739564992) found **445 named complex types: 444 marked structurally resolved, 1 incomplete; 376 with attribute defaults or fixed values**. An incomplete type's underlying reference still needs source-specific triage, and structural resolution is **not** assessor execution equivalence.
- [0d294d4](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/0d294d4ed93ccc31d2c9affe1d88a4be160b20de) adds exact incomplete-type details to the summary; [5a957d2](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/5a957d2592e7eb5db42e8bfb556f7b28200415d0) ensures changes to the resolver itself trigger the pinned schema audit. The latter CI must complete before acceptance.

### Incorrect missing-type finding resolved — 2026-09-30

The pinned OVAL XSD audit at [run 36739750618](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36739750618) identified the sole incomplete named type: `oval-common:SchemaVersionType` extends `oval-common:SchemaVersionPattern`, which is a **named simpleType**, not a complexType. This was a limitation of our resolver and **must not be recorded as an upstream XSD defect**.

- [16ad151](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/16ad1515e9809a8b4e6e64ce15e6654b5c833d1f) registers named simple types and handles them as valid attribute-free `simpleContent` bases only; `complexContent` still requires a complex type.
- [e3c6961](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/e3c69613242c3747dbd2bea299026681e962c9c3) adds an independent synthetic XSD regression reproducing the simple-type-base case.
- [Audit CI 36739970597](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36739970597) triggered and queued when this was recorded. Expected after verification: all 445 globally named complex types structurally resolved, but still no claim of full runtime defaults or Schematron/prose behavior closure.


### Pinned complete named-type structural resolution — 2026-09-30

[Run 36739970597](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36739970597) PASSED including two synthetic fixtures. **445/445 named global complex types structurally resolved**, 0 incomplete, 376 types with defaults/fixed; 54 pinned XSD files parsed. The prior one incomplete report was a false positive: `oval-common:SchemaVersionType` correctly extends a named **simpleType**, `SchemaVersionPattern`, via `simpleContent`; no upstream XSD flaw should be asserted. These are *structural*, not runtime/evaluator semantic equivalence, results.

[3700519](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/37005193d097dfe66b05bfa9e28221b0837e761e) adds a source-backed crosswalk between seven OVAL 5.12.3 generic base types and the explicit importer default catalog; [e2885dd](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/commit/e2885ddddc2efb051edd7192685b54a347d24483) gates it in pinned schema CI [36740291944](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36740291944), queued at note time. Next: analyze any crosswalk differences, XSD documentation-only defaults, state variable conditional rules and platform collector behaviors.


## Test/Object/State capability pairing evidence (2026-09-30)

[Successful pinned validation workflow](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/actions/runs/36747126738): RHEL9 + Win11 NIWC source at `8c8e5dff860af6b1290ee9273a282db24278f8d5`, 1,026 direct Tests, 1,026 Object refs, 797 State refs, **zero type mismatches, missing targets, or duplicate IDs**. Upstream OVAL 5.12.3 schema inspection finds explicit typed Schematron assertions for 251/258 provisional Test types; seven exceptions: independent.unknown; Junos show/version/xml_show; Windows license/peheader/systemmetric. The Junos exceptions still describe required matching typed references, a potential upstream Schematron coverage gap. Full schema-level semantic verification remains open.

[Design and evidence ledger](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/blob/main/research/iterations/003/design/test-check-collection-terminology-review.md) now records the **candidate one-Test-capability, inherited collection/state type contract**. Do not drop raw type identities or silently coerce mismatches until a definitive versioned NG validator rejects unsupported combinations (including nested sets and filters), with negative regression fixtures. No Board vote yet.

issues.body:
**Proposed milestone:** M0. **Track:** SCAP-NG roadmap.

**Goal:** Confirm the `entity_existence` forward/reverse correction against pinned OVAL Self-Assertion and published STIG corpora; establish a versioned baseline.

**Work:** Retain separate production-vs-Self-Assertion metrics; track passes, semantic mismatches, unsupported/deprecated tests, XSD/Schematron failures, and failure categories. Compare the 2026-09-30 pre-fix Solaris/macOS/Apache findings to current results without presuming everything is fixed.

**Done when:** A reproducible source-pinned report with per-definition diagnostics is committed; no unexplained semantic differences are relabeled as harmless serialization changes. Link passing workflows and remaining blockers.

**Dependencies:** Current v003 existence tests and comparator. **Status:** In progress; individual workflows have passed but the full baseline is not signed off.

**Tracking:** See `ROADMAP.md` for milestone definitions and dependencies. Do not close without linking committed implementation and proof. 

### Owner direction — XML → native NG → XML review (2026-09-30)

- Run complete pinned XML → NG → XML round trips, preserving separate OVAL semantic fidelity checks and XCCDF benchmark/policy/profile semantics as applicable. Prioritize **RHEL 9** and **Windows 11** reviewer handoffs after the updated converter passes its relevant gates; do not imply either is ready based merely on generated output.
- Record three categories independently: (1) genuine behavioral/semantic mismatches (block acceptance until explained/fixed), (2) schema-validation failures or unsupported constructs (explicit blocker/diagnostic), and (3) **explainable XML serialization/structural differences** induced by intentional native NG design decisions (nonblocking only after semantic equivalence is demonstrated).
- Examples of possible category (3), subject to proof: making an inherited/default value explicit, dereferencing `extend_definition`, harmless ordering/serialization changes, or NG-native organization requiring different reverse-emitted XML structure.
- Produce a reviewer-friendly diff classification with counts, concrete representative original/reconstructed XML examples, source/NG/back-converted artifact paths and test evidence. Flag any choice that causes significant XML noise for owner review, but **do not redesign native NG solely to eliminate harmless round-trip diff noise** unless there is a separate substantive justification.
- Preserve a distinct provenance/mapping trail so future reviewers can identify what changed and why. Benchmark review readiness remains gated independently by issues #13 (RHEL 9), #14 (Windows 11), #30 (profile inheritance), and #31 (explicit policy linkage).


### Required statistics for revised round-trip report (owner request, 2026-09-30)

Include a concise comparison to the prior pinned run, with a stable report artifact and exact source pin/converter commit/date/command and counts for:

1. **Coverage by corpus**: OVAL Community Self-Assertion versus NIWC published production STIG corpus, never pooled as proof of the same claim. Identify RHEL 9 and Windows 11 separately; count input benchmarks, rules, definitions, test/object/state/variable references, resolved dependency graphs, and deprecated/unsupported constructs. Identify whether all rules or only a subset participated.
2. **Round-trip stage outcomes**: imported, native NG emitted, reverse XML emitted, XML schema/Schematron-valid, structurally compared, semantically compared; give numerators/denominators and percentages at each gate.
3. **Semantic deltas**: equivalent; verified benign default-expansion / NG intentional-representation noise; real mismatches; inconclusive/unproven; unsupported or invalid source. Count by *definition* and *rule* where meaningful and list representative cause categories (existence, var_check, inherited behaviors, set/filter, functions, result propagation, profiles/check selectors).
4. **Diff noise measurements**: XML elements/attributes added, removed, changed or reordered, classified independently of semantic equivalence; show before/after count and representative source/XML/NG/re-emitted XML snippets. Do not count normalization as a semantic pass without evidence.
5. **Regression and trend**: baseline-to-current changed failure categories, newly passing, newly failing, unresolved and known regressions, plus regression test/CI results. Zero-divisor and excluded-source accounting shall be explicit.
6. **Review summary**: short human-readable table for RHEL 9 and Windows 11 plus links to machine-readable per-definition diagnostics and exact reproducible commands/artifacts. Do not assert complete semantic coverage based only on a round-trip serialization pass.

Do not mark the report completed until real execution evidence exists. Share the measured figures with the owner when the revised run finishes.
